title: Data Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
For our European Headquarters in Frankfurt am Main area (Offenbach) we are looking for an IT professional as a




Data Engineer (f/m/d)




who has hands-on experience in designing and developing data marts and databases to support analytical and business intelligence (BI) initiatives. This role will play a key part in building scalable data infrastructure that enables data-driven decision-making across the group. We offer a hybrid working model with regular collaboration days in Offenbach and remote work on the remaining weekdays.




Key Responsibilities:

 * Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and reliable data pipelines to ingest, transform, and load data from diverse sources (ERP, CRM, web/SNS platforms).
 * Integrating structured and unstructured data to create unified views for customer and sales analytics.
 * Building and optimizing ETL/ELT workflows using modern data pipeline frameworks for analytics and data warehousing.
 * Collaborating with data analysts, data stewards to understand requirements and deliver analytics-ready datasets.
 * Ensuring data quality, consistency, and compliance with data governance and privacy standards (e.g., GDPR).
 * Partnering with IT, marketing, and sales teams to align technical data workflows with business objectives.
 * Monitoring data flows, identifying anomalies, and proactively troubleshooting pipeline and infrastructure issues.




Requirements:

 * 3–5 years of experience in data engineering or a related technical role.
 * Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, engineering, or a related field.
 * Strong command of SQL and scripting in Python or Scala.
 * Hands-on experience with data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, DBT, Talend).
 * Solid understanding of data warehousing and cloud-based analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery).
 * Familiarity with data modeling, performance tuning, and partitioning strategies.
 * Strong teamwork capabilities with experience working in cross-functional, multicultural environments.
 * Excellent English proficiency (both written and spoken) for effective collaboration with global teams and stakeholders.




Nice to have

 * Experience with Salesforce data architecture (objects, APIs, data models).
 * Understanding of SAP data integration, especially in automotive or sales domains.
 * Exposure to web/SNS data pipelines (clickstreams, user interaction, social media feeds).
 * Practical experience working with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
 * Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).




Offer & Benefits:

 * Flexible working time and a hybrid work arrangement.
 * Work in an international team and versatile environment
 * Varied tasks with exciting and challenging IT projects
 * Function-specific, personal, and technology training
 * Attractive salary and excellent compensation and benefits package, including free lunch (as lunch vouchers or in the canteen), a free monthly ticket for public transportation and Gympass to support your wellbeing.
 * Relocation support




About us

Hyundai AutoEver Europe GmbH (HAEE) is a fully-owned subsidiary of the Hyundai & KIA Motor Group with its Headquarters in Seoul (South Korea). HAEE has its European Headquarters in Germany and affiliates in Slovakia and the Czech Republic.




We provide IT services that support the innovation and the IT competitiveness of the Hyundai and KIA Motors companies in various European countries, in areas like sales and manufacturing system development, implementation, and operation.




Follow us

https://www.linkedin.com/company/hyundai-autoever-europe-gmbh/




Are you IT-driven?

Embrace challenge and diversity and become part of our team!

title: Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Ihre Aufgaben


 * Requirements Engineering: Technische Aufnahme und Analyse komplexer Kundenanforderungen sowie deren Übersetzung in skalierbare Datenarchitekturen.
 * Architecture & Development: Konzeption und Implementierung von modernen Datenbankstrukturen, Datenmodellen sowie hochverfügbaren Daten-Pipelines und Backend-Anwendungen.
 * Pipeline-Operations: Automatisierung und Orchestrierung von Workflows (CI/CD) zur Sicherstellung einer maximalen Datenqualität und Systemstabilität im Produktivbetrieb.
 * Data Integration: Anbindung, Transformation und Bereinigung heterogener Datenquellen – von REST-APIs und Flatfiles bis hin zu komplexen relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanksystemen.
 * Agile Engineering: Aktive Mitgestaltung des Entwicklungszyklus in enger Abstimmung mit Kunden und Teamkollegen durch agile Methoden (Prototyping, MVP-Entwicklung, Sprints).
   
   

Ihr Profil


 * Akademisches Fundament: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im MINT-Bereich (Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwesen) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit starkem technischem Fokus.
 * Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung in der aktiven Umsetzung von Data Engineering Use Cases mit.
 * Core Skills: Tiefgreifende Kenntnisse in der Datenbankmodellierung sowie in der Konzeption und Implementierung von ETL/ELT-Strecken und modernen Data Warehouse/Lake-Strukturen.
 * Programming: Du beherrschst SQL auf Expertenniveau und bist sicher im Umgang mit mindestens einer weiteren Programmiersprache – idealerweise Python.
 * Tech-Stack & Cloud: Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit modernen Data-Plattformen wie Databricks oder Snowflake gesammelt und fühlst Dich in Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS, Azure oder GCP) zu Hause. Kenntnisse in Big-Data-Frameworks (z. B. Spark) sind ein großes Plus.
 * Agile Engineering: Du bist vertraut mit agilen Arbeitsweisen (Scrum, Kanban) und verstehst es, technische Anforderungen in iterativen Sprints umzusetzen.
 * Deine Persönlichkeit: Du arbeitest hochgradig analytisch und strukturiert. Deine Arbeitsweise ist geprägt von Zuverlässigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und dem Anspruch an "Clean Code".
   
   

Warum wir?

Du brennst für hocheffiziente Pipelines und skalierbare Infrastrukturen?

Bei uns gestaltest du die digitale Transformation aktiv mit, indem du Prozesse automatisierst und leistungsstarke Architekturen für unsere Kunden realisierst. Nutze unsere Partnerschaften mit Branchenführern wie Databricks und AWS, um Datenflüsse auf das nächste Level zu heben. Die Position ist als hybrid role mit flexiblen Remote-Tagen angelegt; für Teamtage triffst du dein Team im Office in Essen-Rüttenscheid.

Die ruhrdot GmbH ist eine dynamische, aufstrebende Data & Analytics- sowie ERP-Beratung. Unsere Mission ist es, das Maximum aus den Daten und Systemen unserer Kunden herauszuholen. Als Databricks-, AWS- und Azure-Partner bewegen wir uns an der Speerspitze technologischer Möglichkeiten. Unsere Projekte fokussieren sich auf Data Engineering, Data Strategy Development sowie Science & AI. Mit unseren Lösungen bauen wir das technische Fundament für leistungsstarke IT-Landschaften und digitalisieren, automatisieren und optimieren die Prozesse unserer Kunden.

Was wir als Arbeitgeber bieten:


 * Wir sind ein buntes internationales, engagiertes und dynamisches Team, das mit Leidenschaft die Zusammenarbeit und Eigenverantwortung fördert
 * Wir arbeiten mit spannenden Kunden von Startups bis hin zu DAX-Konzernen in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell mit Remote-Möglichkeiten und Treffpunkten in unserem modernen Office im Ruhrgebiet in Essen-Rüttenscheid
 * Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben & Herausforderungen bieten dir die Möglichkeit, dich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich weiterzuentwickeln
 * Dich erwartet ein offenes und freundliches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du dich wohlfühlen und dein Potenziel entfalten kannst
 * Gestaltungsspielraum und Austausch sind bei uns besonders gefragt - deiner Kreativität für Ideen und Lösungswege kannst du bei uns freien Lauf lassen
 * Transparente Kommunikation ist uns wichtig - wir teilen Informationen mit regelmäßigen Team-Meetings und geben Feedback
 * Gemeinsam feiern wir (nicht nur in Bezug auf die Arbeit) unsere Erfolge und schaffen einen positiven und motivierenden Teamzusammenhalt
 * Arbeiten mit den neuesten Technologien und innovativen Tools an einem sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einer zukunftsorientierten Branche mit attraktiver Vergütung
 * Modernes Office mit hochwertiger Ausstattung für einen komfortablen Arbeitsalltag und zusätzlicher Top Ausstattung, wie Premium-Notebooks und Smartphones (je nach Position)
 * Flexible Work-Life-Balance durch Home-Office-Optionen
 * Finanzielle Unterstützung für Weiterbildung & persönliche Entwicklung
 * Attraktive Benefits wie Sachbezüge, Teamevents, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Rabatte und vieles mehr...
   
   

Über uns

Prozesse, Daten & Programmierung - das sind unsere Kernkompetenzen.

Wir von der ruhrdot. sind ein dynamisch wachsendes Beratungsunternehmen.

Unser Kerngeschäft ist die Implementierung und Anpassung von ERP-Systemen, die Entwicklung von Add-ons und Schnittstellen sowie Data Analytics und Business Intelligence.

Unsere Mitarbeiter sind bereits seit vielen Jahren als IT-Berater tätig und bringen daher das nötige Know-how für erfolgreiche Projekte mit. Unsere Entwickler und Spezialisten sind zudem in der Lage, individuelle Kundenanforderungen jederzeit schnell und kompetent umzusetzen, um die bestmögliche Lösung zu bieten. Wir versichern, dass wir keine leeren Versprechungen machen und keine Lösungen verkaufen, hinter denen wir nicht zu einhundert Prozent stehen.

Wir lieben Daten und wissen, wie wichtig die Verknüpfung eben dieser Daten für den Unternehmenserfolg ist.

ruhrdot. ist eine smarte Beratung auf großem Wachstumskurs. Alle unsere Mitarbeitenden sind direkt und aktiv in unsern Kundenprojekten involviert und so ein wichtiger Teil unseres Unternehmenserfolges. Die große Bandbreite an unterschiedlichen Kunden - vom traditionsreichen Mittelständler über den Großkonzern bis in zu Start-Ups und Einhörnern - macht die tägliche Arbeit bei uns spannend und abwechslungsreich.

Unser Ziel ist es immer, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden rundum zufrieden zu stellen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass wir dieses Ziel am besten erreichen, indem wir in unseren Projekten stets den größtmöglichen Mehrwert für unsere Kunden im Blick haben.

Unsere Vision:

Optimierte Geschäftsprozesse durch moderne IT.

Unsere Mission:

Wir unterstüzen Unternehmen dabei, ihre Daten effizient zu verwalten und einzusetzen, indem wir ihnen moderne und skalierbare Lösungen aus dem Bereich ERP und Data Analytics anbieten.

Das Team

Die Gründer:

ruhrdot steht für Ehrlichkeit, Erfahrung und Professionalität. Die Gründer sind allesamt studierte Wirtschaftinformatiker und Wirtschaftsmathematiker, IT-Berater sowie Profis für Data Analytics und Geschäftsprozesse. Aus der Praxis der IT-Beratung heraus entstand die Idee, ein eigenes Beratungsunternehmen zu gründen, das IT und Beratung anders denkt und umsetzt.

Unsere Köpfe:

Hinter den erfolgreichen IT-Projekten der ruhrdot. steht ein Team, das unterschiedlicher kaum sein könnte: Bei uns findet man kreative Köpfe, datengetriebene Denker, prozessorientierte Macher, IT-Liebhaber, People- & Culture-Enthusiasten, aber auch kritische Andersdenker und mitdenkende Teamplayer. Unser Team teilt sich in die Bereiche ERP, Data Analytics, Programmierung sowie Backoffice und interne HR. Für unsere erfolgreichen Projekte stellen wir je nach Bedarf immer ein passendes Team zusammen, das mit viel Herzblut und Engagement bei der Sache ist.

title: Junior Credit Decisions Analyst (m/f/d)
description:
About Us

YouLend is the preferred embedded finance platform for many of the world's leading e-commerce platforms, tech companies, and payment service providers. Our software enables partners like eBay, Amazon, Shopify, and Stripe to extend their value proposition by offering flexible financing products to their merchants under their own brand - without taking on capital risk.

Part of the leading private equity firm EQT, we have grown by more than 100% annually since 2020. While our headquarters are in London, we are present in several European countries and the US. For 2026, we are planning a massive expansion in Germany and are opening our new office in Berlin - a unique opportunity for you to join us from the very beginning.

Your Role & Impact

As part of our Credit Decision Team, you will be responsible for the credit assessment of new and existing customers applying for Merchant Cash Advances (MCAs). You will process applications from thousands of German and Danish businesses coming through our global partners.


 * In-depth Analysis: You assess repayment capacity and risk profiles by analyzing financial data, financial statements, and revenue/payment data
 * Structuring: You decide on the terms of financing offers (amount, duration, price), balancing risk with growth
 * Risk & Compliance: Using state-of-the-art third-party systems, you manage KYC checks as well as onboarding and compliance risks
 * Process Optimization: You work closely with other teams to continuously improve our risk engine and internal workflows
   
   

Requirements

Your Profile


 * Analytical Focus: You enjoy working with data and possess high attention to detail
 * Experience: Ideally, you have 1-2 years of experience in underwriting or finance; however, we also welcome highly motivated talents with a strong analytical background
 * Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Excel is a prerequisite
 * Hands-on Mentality: You are proactive, solution-oriented, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with daily deadlines
 * Languages: You communicate confidently and professionally in German and English
   
   

Nice to Have


 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as experience handling large datasets (e.g., SQL, Python, R)
 * Experience in the field of SME financing in Germany, ideally with Cash Advances
   
   

Benefits

At YouLend, we work in an environment that fosters personal responsibility and excellence. Our culture is characterized by:


 * High Performance: A highly skilled team that drives each other to peak performance through direct feedback and aligned incentive systems
 * Team Spirit: A strong, transparent culture - we stand up for one another
 * Impact: An empowered work environment where results matter
 * Agility: A data-driven way of working with a focus on speed and minimal bureaucracy
   
   

Why YouLend?

It is an exciting time to join; YouLend is an organization in the making. We are just at the beginning and growing at high speed.


 * Build-up Opportunity: You will become part of our new team in Berlin and actively help scale the German market
 * Growth & Stability: Over 100% YoY growth meets the security of the Banking Circle Group (with a banking license in Luxembourg) and the backing of EQT
 * Development: Clear career paths and an attractive salary package, including bonus or equity programs
   
   

Salary: Competitive market salary plus bonus

Location: Berlin, Germany (Office-based position)

title: Business Operations Analyst - Transformation (m/w/d)
description:
About Us

YouLend is a rapidly growing FinTech that is the preferred embedded financing platform for many of the world's leading e-commerce platforms, tech companies, and Payment Service Providers. Our software platform enables our partners to extend their value proposition by offering flexible financing products in their own branding, to their merchant base, without capital at risk. 

We are owned by the leading Private Equity company, EQT, and have grown +100% year-on-year since 2020. We are headquartered in London, UK, but are also present in several European countries as well as the United States where we service our partners, including eBay, Amazon, Just Eat, Shopify, and Stripe. 

Over the past year, the importance of the EU market - including Germany - has increased significantly alongside strong growth in financing volumes. By 2026, YouLend expects the total fundings in this region to more than double through new and existing partners. To support these growth ambitions, YouLend has decided to open a new office in Germany.

Requirements

The Role

You will join YouLend's Berlin office as a ‘Business Operations Analyst', supporting the continued growth of our EU Operations function (80+ people expected across Sales, Customer Service and Credit Operations). In this role, you will play a key role in strengthening operational excellence, improving business intelligence, and driving scalable growth through data.

You will act as the on-the-ground support and sparring partner to Team Leaders and Managers, quickly resolving requests and implementing policy and process changes on a local level. The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent stakeholder management capabilities, and the ability to operate independently with a proactive, "get it done" mindset.

Responsibilities:


 * Take full ownership of driving operational excellence across EU Operations, with performance measured through conversion, efficiency, quality, and compliance outcomes
 * Lead local execution of transformation initiatives, ensuring new processes, tools, and policies are effectively implemented and embedded across EU Operations
 * Act as an on-the-ground operational support function and sparring partner to HoDs, Team Leaders, and Managers
 * Drive a strong "get it done" culture, ensuring initiatives move from concept to execution with clear accountability
 * Drive forward KPI reporting and monitoring across the teams to enable better performance tracking (e.g. building and maintaining dashboards) and to identify process gaps and work with the team to close them
 * Own real-time optimization and updates in the CRM tool to increase operational efficiency, including customer-facing communication strategies (e.g. automated emails, call scripts and texts)
 * Help take new products, partners, and markets from zero to one
   
   

The ideal candidate will have the following skillset:


 * 1+ year experience or internships in project management, preferably from fast-paced environments such as consulting firms, start-ups, or scale-ups is preferred
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with basic proficiency in tools like MS Excel
 * Effective written and verbal communication skills
 * Willingness to learn and support change management processes
 * Familiarity with or interest in learning data manipulation tools like SQL, Python, or R is a plus
 * You are proactive, eager to learn, and take initiative to get things done
 * Fluent in German and English
   
   

Benefits

Why YouLend?


 * We have built powerful solutions, secured major partnerships, and are growing at exceptional speed
 * The global growth opportunity is substantial — YouLend is still in build mode, and this is just the beginning
 * You will join the fastest-growing part of the business and play a key role in building and scaling our newest office in Germany
   
   

Significant Growth Potential


 * Strong growth (>100% YoY since 2020) → clear perspectives for salary, bonus, equity, and career development
 * Financially strong thanks to private equity backing
 * Part of the Banking Circle Group with a fully licensed bank in Luxembourg - enabling expansion into complexly regulated markets
   
   

Motivating Work Environment


 * A top-level team that pushes each other and thrives on direct feedback
 * Strong, transparent culture - we stick together
 * High degree of autonomy; results matter
 * Data-driven work style, minimal bureaucracy, fast pace
   
   

Start date: As soon as possible

Salary: Competitive market salary plus bonus

Location: Berlin, Germany (office-based role)

title: Business Analyst
description:
Candidates who are able to work one day per week in Frankfurt or Amsterdam are highly preferred for this position.

Interested in a career that bridges the gap between Supply Chain and Technology?

Elemica, an award-winning, digital supply chain company in the SaaS community, is seeking an experienced Principal Business Analyst to grow our business and strengthen our partnerships with existing top enterprise clients. This is an opportunity to join a growing company of talented and committed individuals, unified in the common goal of exceeding our client’s expectations.

Our Values

At Elemica, We Believe That Embodying Our Values Is Essential For All Team Members. These Qualities Show Up In Our Interactions With Each Other, Our Clients, And Our Collective Community


 * Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them
 * Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners
 * Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently.
 * Passion – We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chain
   
   

What’s In It For You?


 * Competitive Compensation Packages including Bonus Program
 * Hybrid Work Locations & Flexible Work Schedule
 * Attractive Health Insurance & Pension Plan Offerings
 * Global EAP Program
 * Company Discounts
 * Generous Employee Referral Program
 * Bike Leasing/By-a-Bike/Cycle-to-Work Offerings
 * Benefits-in-kind/Wellness Stipends
 * Rewards & Recognition including Years of Service Awards
 * Quarterly Employee Engagement Events
 * Fun Work Environment
   
   

Responsibilities & Objectives

The Elemica Business Analyst is integral to our success and serve as trusted, dedicated advisor to our loyal clients, helping them to achieve success. Key to this role is being able to engage customers (both internal and external), articulate value, and effectively communicate the Elemica story of innovating and digitizing supply chain connectivity. The business analyst must be highly analytical and be hands-on and detail oriented.

What You’ll Do

The Elemica Business Analyst supports three primary functions: Project Coordination, Business Analysis, and Quality Assurance.

On large logistics projects, you will work with a Project Manager and other Business Analysts on new client implementations, EDI carrier integrations and configurations of the Transportation Management System for our clients.


 * Project Coordination:
    * Work with the Project Manager to support the requirements gathering process for the implementation of the logistics focused solutions.
    * Assist in defining requirements/proposed solution, project scope, tasks, efforts and timelines to support trading partner implementation
    * Identify and mitigate issues and risks throughout the project lifecycle

 * Business Analysis/Mapping Function:
    * Assess the customer’s and logistic service providers business and technical messaging requirements and confirm their compatibility with the Elemica supported solutions.
    * Review the design of new business processes for the customer and their adequate integration into the industry standards and best practices.
    * Analyze the customer message formats, identify transformation requirements of their logistics service providers, and document the mapping requirements for the mapping and config team.
    * Configure Elemica logistics focussed solutions in the test and production environments

 * Quality Assurance:
    * Testing and verifying quality of developed interface message output based on the requirements.
    * Coordination and assisting in the execution of client testing activities, such as
       * Assist in business scenario testing
       * Assist in end-to-end partner testing
   
    * Ensure the client and logistics service providers ability to transact on the Elemica network
    * Take an active role in troubleshooting technical problems discovered during the testing process and provide resolution internally and externally

 * Work in a team of experienced Business Analysts
 * As part of the Elemica Professional Services team, you will be driving continuous improvement efforts surrounding the processes and tools utilized in Elemica’s client onboarding process.
   

What You'll Need


 * 2-5 years of work experience in supply chain and logistics.
 * Strong analytical skills within the context of analyzing and mapping disparate data formats
 * Familiarity/experience with one or more of the messaging formats used in B2B e-commerce: EDI (ANSI X12), EDIFACT, XML, SAP iDOCs, Flatfiles, etc.
 * Experience in writing mapping documentation
 * Understanding of SQL and using relational databases
 * Experience with logistics and supply chain processes
 * Exposure or experience with a Transportation Management System
 * Exposure to internet security, networking issues and technologies
 * Familiarity and/or experience with one or more of the communication protocols:
    * HTTPS, AS2, SFTP, IBM MQ, FTPS, ebMS, oFTP, etc.

 * Ability to multi-task integration projects of varying degrees of complexity in a dynamic environment
 * Knowledge and experience with MS Office and Atlassian JIRA
 * Ability to understand industry standard interface specifications.
 * Good communication skills and the ability to speak to a group of people.
 * Fluently in English
 * Desire to work with a collaborative global team with offices in the USA, Germany, UK, Netherlands, and India
   

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Logistics, Supply Chain, or related field of study.

Who We Are

Elemica offers a state–of–the–art supply chain execution platform and ecosystem network in client, supplier, and logistics orchestration, promoting new efficiency and profitability for leaner and more fully optimized supply chains. Elemica’s global clients achieve significant value from reduced cost of operations, faster process execution with fewer resources, removal of transactional barriers, and seamless information flow between systems, internal teams, and business partners. Our Go-to-Market team focuses on solutions for executive change agents including Procurement, Commercial, Logistics, CoE, and Digital leaders, CIOs and Supply Chain Officers.

It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Using best practices in these areas, all Elemica employees will observe a ‘security first’ approach to their daily responsibilities. All employees are accountable for securing their work devices, work areas, and communications in the execution of their daily duties.

title: Applied ML Researcher
description:
At Circonomit, we build the strategic twin of organizations. By transforming operational data into clear decision models, we revolutionize how resources are managed. As an Applied ML Researcher (Lead Modeller), you will take full ownership of the modeling core of our platform. You will work directly with our CTO to design, formalize, and implement the computational and semantic models that translate real-world organizational complexity into executable decision intelligence.

Join our nerdy, fast-paced team to build the models that turn human knowledge and data into strategy.

Responsibilities


 * Lead the modeling core with fundamental mathematical, statistical, and machine-learning methods that bring customer and market data with knowledge into an executable strategic twin
 * Translate business reality into formal models and work closely with product, domain experts, and customers to convert messy, real-world organizational structures into clean, computable abstractions
 * Integrate ML models with ontologies and knowledge graphs to ensure explainability, composability, and traceability of decisions
 * Apply natural language processing techniques to extract meaningful insights from text data and integrate it into data models
 * Present and communicate research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively
 * Stay abreast of the latest developments in the field of machine learning and contribute to the continuous improvement of our technologies
   
   

Requirements


 * Ph.D. or a Master's degree in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field
 * 4+ years of experience in applied machine learning research or implementation
 * Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, with experience in machine learning libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)
 * Strong foundation in designing models from scratch, explicitly not just tuning existing architectures, with owning tech decisions with their assumptions, limitations, and trade-offs in model design
 * Strong knowledge of natural language processing techniques and tools
 * Strong experience in connecting ML models with semantic representations to capture domain logic and dependencies, understanding ontologies and knowledge graphs
 * Solid mathematical and statistical background in optimization, probabilistic modeling, time-series analysis, graph-based models, or simulation
 * Proven ability to conduct rigorous research and develop innovative solutions to complex problems
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and curious mindset
 * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences
 * You must speak German at a level C1 or higher
 * You must speak English at a level C1 or higher
 * You already live or are willing to relocate to Cologne, Germany
   
   

Benefits


 * You join as part of the core team to shape the technical foundation and story of our company
 * We empower you with ownership and decision-making authority to build, test, and lead starting day one
 * We ensure you have skin in the game by offering both a competitive salary and a significant equity package
 * We fully cover your Urban Sports Club membership because we believe that high performance relies on active recovery
 * You have the space to learn and progress quickly, encouraged by the contagious curiosity and ambition of our team
   
   

Can't wait to chat!

"Hustle the day, analyze at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

Erik & Dana

title: Head of Analytics
description:
About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

About The Role

We are looking for a Head of Analytics who is a builder at heart to lead our Business Analytics and Product Analytics functions. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Finance, you will operate as a central data leader with influence spanning the entire organization—from Product and Engineering to Commercial and Operations.

In this role, you will be the bridge between raw data and strategic business decisions, acting as a true “player-coach.” In this role, you will balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution, actively contributing to the development of a scalable and integrated data landscape. You will drive the evolution of our analytics capabilities, moving from simply reporting on the past to providing forward looking insights which actively shape the future, ensuring that Forto’s data is not just accurate and actionable, but a world class competitive advantage.

Key Responsibilities


 * Lead & Develop the Team: You will manage and mentor the Analytics professionals. You are responsible for transforming this group into a world-class analytics unit, fostering a culture of curiosity, rigor, and rapid delivery.
 * Hands-On Execution: You will lead by example. We are a fast-paced scale-up, and in our high-growth environment, you will actively maintain a hands-on presence – architecting complex data models, developing critical dashboards, and executing high-priority analyses alongside your team.
 * Shape Data Strategy: You will move us beyond “service desk analytics” to “strategic partnership.” You will proactively identify growth levers, efficiency bottlenecks, and product opportunities using data.
 * Drive Data Quality and ensure Data Governance: You will be the primary feedback loop to our Data Engineering and product team. You won’t just consume data; you will actively collaborate with engineers to define requirements, fix quality issues upstream, and improve our data modeling standards.
 * Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will sit at the intersection of Business, Product, and Engineering. You will work closely with Product Managers to define success metrics and with various leaders to optimize business performance.
   
   

Required Skills And Experience


 * 7+ years in Data Analytics or Data Science;
 * At least 4+ years of experience leading and managing teams in a high-growth, fast-paced environment (Scale-up or Tech startup preferred).
 * Advanced proficiency in SQL and modern analytics tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau) and can review your team’s code and logic effectively. Python/R skills are a strong plus.
 * Augmented Intelligence: Drive the transition from descriptive to predictive analytics by architecting an AI-first data roadmap, leveraging LLMs and Machine Learning to automate insight generation and reduce ‘time-to-decision’.
 * Strategic Vision: You understand that data is a product. You have experience building analytics roadmaps that align with company OKRs and have a track record of using data to change business outcomes.
 * Engineering Fluency: You speak the language of Data Engineering. You understand data warehousing concepts (e.g., dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery) well enough to give technical feedback on data models and pipelines.

 * At least 4+ years experience in hiring, developing, and retaining top talent. You know how to give radical candor with care and build a psychological safe environment for your team.
   
   

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit!

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.
